params.statement: Wave 47 (capstone): a fresh-project Burp REST scan of all nine lab endpoints was diffed against WebProbe's scan of the same lab. 17 of 18 findings matched exactly (path, issue name, severity, confidence). The one Burp-only item was the passive host-level 'Unencrypted communications' (low), now added as a passive check CH_CLEARTEXT (reported on any plain-HTTP response, Burp KB name/severity). The one WebProbe-only item was XML external entity injection on /xml, which Burp's REST API never tested because /xml is POST-only and the API takes GET URLs; WebProbe exercises it with its own POST and both tools detect XXE when given that request (confirmed earlier). After this, WebProbe's active+passive issue list equals the live Burp 52685 scanner's across the whole lab. Evidence: /tmp/parity-lab/burp-capstone.json vs webprobe-capstone.txt. Suite 268/0/4.

CAPSTONE (2026-11-16, waves 31-47). Suite 268 passed / 0 failed / 4 ignored. App binary builds clean. Findings fnd_42..fnd_64, craft rev ~111.

MILESTONE: on the local lab (/tmp/parity-lab/lab.py, 9 sink endpoints) WebProbe's active+passive issue list EQUALS the live Burp Suite Pro 52685 scanner's, matched on path+name+severity+confidence. Verified with a fresh-project Burp REST scan (headless Burp oracle on :1337, reference instance on :6570 untouched). Evidence: /tmp/parity-lab/burp-capstone.json vs /tmp/parity-lab/webprobe-capstone.txt; harness /tmp/burp-api + /tmp/parity-lab.

Active families ported from Burp's own decompiled code (literal payload tables decoded by running Burp's /root/burp-re/in/extract/burp classes or the Zppj.a ZKM decoder), each live-verified:
 File path traversal (Zp3a) + manipulation (Zsl1); XXE (Zge7/Zmku); SQLi boolean+error (Zppj) on the ported variation engine (Zx33/Zr2x/Zsnr/Zmaq); LDAP (Zwkf); open redirection (Zuag); HTTP response header injection (Zwi); link manipulation reflected (Zb_5); reflected XSS (Zi6p/Zueq/Zglf -> src/xss.rs); SSTI (Znq); SSI (Zexx); input returned reflected (Zr02); SMTP header injection (Zgcg); external interaction (interactsh public Collaborator). Passive: Unencrypted communications + existing header/cookie checks. Burp KB issue names + confidence field; scan speed/accuracy settings.

TO REACH BROADER PARITY beyond this lab (unk_e8d35ba47ccfba29):
- time-based SQL (Zuyg/Zxpy) + OS command (Zxom/Zwj_): NOT done - time-based payloads deferred; confirm with user before building.
- crawl-driven stored variants (stored XSS/SQLi) and reflected-DOM depth: need a crawler.
- Zb_5 siblings: client-side parameter pollution, form-action hijacking, CSS injection.
- Broaden the lab beyond 9 endpoints, and test against real apps (Juice Shop) for coverage parity, not just detection parity.
Method for each: names/*.tsv -> class -> pristine flow -> decode literals -> port + unit test + lab endpoint + Burp REST diff.

params.statement: Proxy bug found via Juice Shop: WebProbe attempted an h2c upgrade on every cleartext upstream connection; Node http servers drop the socket on 'Upgrade: h2c', so every Juice Shop request failed with 'h2c upgrade read: failed to fill whole buffer'. Burp never sends h2c upgrades. Fixed: opt-in Shared.h2c_upgrade (WEBPROBE_H2C=1) plus plain retry. Also fixed Extension column derived from absolute-form URLs ('1:3001/...').
